scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 Kind cluster runs a digest-pinned OpenTelemetry Collector and synthetic Python OpenTelemetry SDK ingestion, registry and inference services plus native asynchronous training Jobs. The raw Collector output proves exact parentage, separation when the Job omits context, and an inference error marker on the intended trace. An additional fixture tests a native Job and KServe Standard-mode predictor annotation handoff with exact W3C parentage. Deployed orchestration coverage, telemetry governance and durable backends require separate evidence.
